description: This file defines a mock class 'DecryptionServiceMock' for the 'IDecryptionService' interface, used in unit testing to simulate decryption service behavior in the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for decrypting media, checking key system type, selecting key IDs, and managing session usage counters.

classes.name: DecryptionServiceMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IDecryptionService for unit testing, providing mocked methods for media decryption and session management.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks the decryption of media data given a session ID, encrypted buffer, and caps.

methods.name: decrypt (overload)
methods.description: Mocks the decryption process with additional parameters including subsample, IV, key ID, and initialization flag.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks the check if the key system is PlayReady for a given session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks the selection of a key ID for a given session ID.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks incrementing the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Mocks decrementing the usage counter for a session ID.
